Copy of https://github.com/friggog/tree-gen (GPL-3.0, see LICENSE) used unmodified, apart from the
package layout. It is Chris Hewitt's implementation of Weber and Penn for Blender. `shims/` holds
small stand-ins for bpy, bmesh and mathutils so the generator runs without Blender.
This is research material. Code that ships inside the app should not be copied from here, since the
GPL would then apply to the app.
